problems.title: Minimum Coins to Form All Amounts

numeric_complexity_contract.reference: breadth-first search over (reachable prefix, largest coin used) states adding coins in non-decreasing order, each at most reachable + 1
numeric_complexity_contract.candidate_design: greedy on sorted distinct denominations: repeatedly add the largest coin not above reachable + 1, jumping many identical picks at once with integer division
numeric_complexity_contract.complexity_target: O(k log k) time/O(k) space, k = number of denominations
